title: Endorser exemption from penalty
description: Endorser not liable to penalty if due diligence exercised

content.general_rule: Endorser is liable to a penalty under sub-sections (2) and (3)
content.exception: Endorser is not liable to a penalty if he has exercised due diligence to verify the veracity of the claims made in the advertisement
conditions: he has exercised due diligence to verify the veracity of the claims made in the advertisement regarding the product or service being endorsed by him
